messages:
Nina: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — want to enumerate immediate eval/test work and owners so nothing slips.
Raj: Thanks. happy to own the load/replay pieces.
Nina: Great. High-level plan: (A) crash/regression prompt set for the fallback path; (B) replay load test to model the short burst + long tail responses; (C) KV/Cache eviction chaos drill in staging; (D) CI light eval gating (warn-first -> block later).
Priya: Will take (A). Can you paste a few of the real-ish prompts so I can craft tests that are low-noise?
Nina: Scrubbed examples: 
```
"Condense this support thread into three action items and assign likely owners."
"Given previous messages, write a single-paragraph follow-up that confirms next steps."
"Rank these candidate answers for intent Y and state the top rationale in one sentence."
```
Raj: For (B) I'll add a locust/k6 scenario that replays user sequences including a few "long gen" steps per session. Target: 150-250 concurrent for 30-90s bursts, with 10s ramps.
Sam: For (C) I'll schedule a chaos job that forces aggressive KV eviction and a few combos of instance restarts. I want to capture per-model p50/p95/p99 and error rates.
Jules: Can we set a rollback threshold? e.g., if p99 increases >40% OR error rate >1% during runs, flag as failure in the runbook.
Nina: Yes. Add gating thresholds to the runbook and CI notes. Initial CI job should only warn on threshold breach; after two clean runs we flip to block-on-failure.
Priya: I'll create the regression harness and keep prompts strict to avoid flakiness. Plan: 8-12 small test cases derived from scrubbed traces + 3 synthetic edge cases. Due in 4 business days.
Raj: I'll put replay configs under eng-ml/replay/incident-1770456789 with a dockerized invoker and an exact command in the README. Target first run in staging in 5 business days.
Sam: Chaos drill scheduled for staging in 10 days and I'll add a Grafana dashboard panel for p99-by-model during eviction windows.
Jules: Who's owning the JIRA tracking and followups?
Nina: I'll create tracking tickets and assign owners now. Ticket numbers will be posted here. Also adding a recurring agenda item to the 1:1 triage for the next 3 weeks to look at regressions.
CI Bot: Please create JIRA tickets and tag them with label incident-1770456789.
Priya: Quick Q: do we want to gate both the fallback path and the main generation path? Might be overkill initially.
Nina: Start with the fallback path (it failed in the incident). We can expand after we get stable signals.
Raj: One more ask: include an experiment where we run the replay against both the quantized and the full-precision variants to see if behavior diverges.
Sam: Good idea. I'll ensure chaos runs hit both variants.
Priya: I'll open a PR to eng-ml/evals/regressions/incident-1770456789 with the initial tests and tag it evals:nonblocking.
Nina: Decision on CI mode: warn-only until we see 2 consecutive passing runs in staging (no threshold breaches), then flip to blocking for subsequent deploys.
Jules: Logging requirement: ensure the eval job stores per-run artifacts (input prompts, model variant, outputs, random seed) for debugging.
Raj: Will include artifact upload to the eval store and link in the run output.
CI Bot: JIRA ticket created: RW-INC-4012; EVAL ticket: RW-EVAL-920.
Nina: Posting links: https://git.redwood.co/r/1450 (replay), https://git.redwood.co/r/1451 (regression harness). I'll post CI shards when they finish.
Priya: PR opened and linked to RW-EVAL-920. Tests minimal for now; will expand after a first-run audit.
Sam: I'll share the dashboard panel link and schedule the chaos window with @ops.
Nina: Thanks everyone. Let's reconvene Friday in #eng-ml for status and to decide whether to flip CI gating.
Raj: :thumbsup:
Priya: On it :rocket:
